items.q: the board members consisted of Harry Belafonte and Ossie Davis

ctx.x: people stood up so long I thought I'd done something wrong. I said, 'What the hell did I do wrong'? They said, 'You're a big hit.'

And I most certainly intend to see...and what actually happened was that Assemblyman George W. Miller called a meeting to report on this affair and the board members…
